title: CERTIFICATE IN STUDIO ART - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Visual Arts

sections.heading: CERTIFICATE IN STUDIO ART - ADMISSION DISCONTINUED
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Visual Arts

Admission to this certificate is discontinued, effective September 1, 2025. Students currently enrolled in the certificate will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the certificate requirements by August 31, 2028.
Completion of first-year requirements, including Studio Art 1601 or Studio Art 1605, or the former VAS 1025 or the former VAS 1020 with a minimum grade of 60%.
0.5 course from: Studio Art 2500A/B or the former VAS 2274A/B, Studio Art 2502A/B or the former VAS 2275A/B or Studio Art 2504Y or the former VAS 2276Y.
2.5 courses from: Studio Art 2600-level or above or the former VAS at the 2200-level or above.
Note: Students may substitute Studio Art 2508A/B, Studio Art 2510A/B, Studio Art 2560A/B for a Studio Art 2600 level course.
For modules that can and cannot be combined, please visit the Visual Arts Modular Checklist site https://www.uwo.ca/visarts/undergraduate/Modules.html
